calculation.description: Fade each instrument's idiosyncratic three-day weakness relative to the cross-sectional median, activated only when at least half of the tradable universe has negative five-day returns; cross-sectional z-normalization makes the signal comparable across regimes. Uses only data through the prior completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission gate passed across 134 valid dates with a small 15-asset cross-section; interpretation remains conservative. Signal is intentionally sparse because it activates only in broad stress, with strengthening regime IC in 2023-2027.
